page.description: Field notes from building and evaluating AI agents, developer tools, and agentic systems — including experiments that fail.

findings.title: An llms.txt response was observed
findings.evidence: 18003 response bytes; links are counted without fetching them.
findings.recommendation: Keep the directory accurate if you maintain it. Presence does not prove discovery, ranking, use or citation.

limits: complete means every planned resource returned a bounded response and robots parsing/evaluation did not exceed a local policy budget. It does not mean every policy is known, every response succeeds, or an AI provider can use the site.
One page and fixed root discovery paths; no site crawl, browser execution, provider login, search-result check or citation trial.
Robots decisions apply to the final page path and declared product token. They are policy interpretations, not access authorization or proof that a provider follows them.

Training-control groups are policy tokens for training or secondary reuse, not evidence that a particular request trains a model. Google-Extended also governs some grounding uses; Applebot-Extended controls secondary reuse, and CCBot builds a general web corpus. Consult each provider source for its exact scope.
The three named User-Agent probes are synthetic requests from this audit. They do not authenticate or reproduce OpenAI, Anthropic or Perplexity infrastructure.

HTML text and metadata are bounded source-level observations. Response header values longer than 2,048 characters are omitted and remain unassessed. These observations do not establish rendered visibility, schema validity, answer quality or what an assistant extracts.
llms.txt, Markdown, sitemap and structured-data presence do not establish ranking, recommendation, training use or citation.

At most 12 target GETs including redirects, three redirects per resource, 512 KiB per response and a 22-second transport deadline. Robots parsing is limited to 10,000 lines/5,000 rules/8,192 characters per line and wildcard comparison to 200,000 steps per token; policy-limit results remain unknown. Partial failures remain visible.
Public HTTPS only. Production safety depends on Cloudflare Workers global_fetch_strictly_public connection-time network filtering, in addition to URL and DNS preflight checks.

Saved controlled example captured with Sec-Purpose: prefetch on own-site requests to exclude these controls from routine audience observations. This header is not sent by the hosted checker. The capture predates the homepage Markdown repair.

assessment.label: Technical access score

checks.title: Successful page response
checks.nextStep: For a public page, compare a direct fetch and edge logs when this response fails. This checker is not a real provider trial.

checks.title: HTML response type
checks.nextStep: Serve the intended HTML with its correct media type. Other resource types may be intentional and fall outside this page baseline.

checks.title: Text in the initial HTML
checks.evidence: 10713 source text characters were observed outside excluded elements.
checks.nextStep: Put useful content in the initial HTML when possible. This count can include navigation and does not establish meaningful answers or rendered visibility.

checks.title: Nonempty page title
checks.evidence: Title: Goga Koreli — Agentic Engineering Field Notes
checks.nextStep: Give the page a descriptive title. This checklist weight is a local heuristic, not a ranking weight.

checks.title: At least one source heading
checks.nextStep: Use headings that explain the content. A heading count does not validate hierarchy or make a claim about provider extraction.

checks.title: No general noindex directive observed
checks.evidence: The captured general controls contain no noindex/none directive.
checks.nextStep: If public indexing is your goal, review generic noindex/none controls. They may be intentional. Provider-scoped controls, crawl policy, actual indexing and assistant use remain separate.

optional.title: Optional llms.txt directory
optional.nextStep: Keep the directory accurate. Presence does not establish ranking, discovery or citation.

optional.title: Sitemap at the fixed root path
optional.nextStep: Maintain the sitemap with canonical URLs. The checker observes its root element and does not validate every entry.

optional.title: Optional Markdown negotiation
optional.nextStep: This URL returned HTML when Markdown was requested. That optional format is not required for the HTML to be readable. Check a declared alternate or add negotiation only if useful.

optional.title: Optional JSON-LD syntax
optional.evidence: 1 JSON-LD blocks; 0 did not parse as JSON.
optional.nextStep: Publish accurate structured data when it serves your page. Absence does not lower this score.

limits: This is a versioned local technical checklist for a public HTML page, not a calibrated AI-readiness, ranking, citation or quality predictor. The displayed weights are product heuristics.
Delivery contributes 40 points, initial HTML source 40 and general indexing controls 20. Intentional generic noindex can lower the index without being a defect.
Unknown points form the displayed lower–upper interval over 100. Coverage counts points with observed pass/fail outcomes; missing evidence never becomes a passed or failed check.
Training/reuse blocks, provider-specific robots decisions and optional Markdown, llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD or citation-format absence do not deduct points.

Header omission, metadata capture limits, legacy reports without completeness flags and ambiguous provider-scoped headers keep indexing points unknown unless a generic restriction is positively observed.
This report does not establish actual indexing or the access, selection, citation, training use or answer quality of any AI provider.
